$comment: Link targets for the printed references. The reference text is shown exactly as printed; only the link changes. A string replaces a printed address that does not resolve with the verified record for the same work (matched on title, first author and year at Crossref). null shows the reference unlinked because the printed address is dead and no record of the work was found. Checked 13 Oct 2026. Details: the correction note to the journal.

notes.https://www.medicaid.gov/federal-policy-: Source verification pending: the printed document could not be located. Related CMS guidance does not establish the article's broader funding claim, so it has not been substituted here.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings1304092: Source verification pending: the printed DOI identifies a different article about building water disruptions. No verified match for the cited work has been established.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envres.2021.11: Source verification pending: the printed DOI identifies a different work about selective outcome reporting. A related Yao paper was found, but its authors, title and journal differ from this citation; it has not been silently substituted.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envres.2022.11: Source verification pending: the printed DOI identifies a study of ultrafine particles and myocardial infarction. The cited Rony systematic review has not been located; a related perspective is a different publication.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1002/hipo.22712: Source verification pending: the printed DOI identifies a mouse spatial-cognition study, not the cited Bohbot wayfinding paper. No verified matching record has been established.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.20: Source verification pending: the printed DOI identifies a metakaolin geopolymer study, not the cited Peñaloza timber life-cycle review. No verified matching record has been established.
Corrected destination: Bartesaghi Koc, Osmond and Peters, Evaluating the cooling effects of green infrastructure: A systematic review of methods, indicators and data sources, Solar Energy (2018). The printed author list and journal differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1186/s41018-022-00123: Bibliographic note: this identifier names Conzatti, Kershaw, Copping and Coley, A review of the impact of shelter design on the health of displaced populations. The printed author list and title differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings1508128: Bibliographic note: this identifier names Al-Homoud and Samarah, Redesigning Refuge: Spatial Adaptations and Defensible Space Principles in Zaatari Camp in Jordan. The printed author list and title differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/su16209127: Bibliographic note: this identifier names Al-Shoubaki and colleagues, A Human-Centered Shelter Design for People on the Move in the Al-Sahel Region. The printed author list and title differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/ijerph20095637: Bibliographic note: the indexed title is Architectural Allostatic Overloading: Exploring a Connection between Architectural Form and Allostatic Overloading, by Valentine.
notes.https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/article: Bibliographic note: this record is by Rebecca L Ames and Janet E Loebach, Applying Trauma-Informed Design Principles to Therapeutic Residential Care Facilities to Reduce Retraumatization and Promote Resiliency Among Youth in Care, Journal of Child & Adolescent Trauma (2023). The printed authors, title and journal differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3389/fbuil.2024.14676: Bibliographic note: the author names are Al Khatib I, Samara F and Ndiaye M; the printed initials differ.
Bibliographic note: the indexed subtitle is Please don’t make me sit in the middle, rather than Passenger reactions.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.susmat.2015.05: Bibliographic note: the indexed publication year is 2015, rather than the printed 2017.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1021/es403688w: Bibliographic note: the indexed title is Longitudinal effects on mental health of moving to greener and less green urban areas; the printed title is a paraphrase.
notes.https://journals.ed.ac.uk/ear/article/vi: The printed address identifies Emma van Daal’s Entanglement of trauma spaces, published 29 January 2024 in an issue dated 2023. It is not the cited Shepley and Sachs neighborhood-trauma review. The intended work has not been verified; preserve the printed reference as historical text and do not silently relabel it.

Printed initials, issue and page range differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings1407077: Corrected record is by Cleo Valentine, Tony Steffert, Heather Mitcheltree and Koen Steemers, Buildings 14(5),1292. Printed authors and volume/issue/article details differ. The abstract explicitly reports no statistically significant relative-alpha change.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1177/1937586710004002: The verified Golembiewski work appears in Facilities 28(3/4),100–117 (2010), not the printed HERD journal/volume/pages.
